purpose: Define the steps for processing an internal expense-reimbursement request so that requests are handled consistently and within the promised turnaround time.
scope: Applies to all staff submitting an expense-reimbursement request through the finance department. Does not cover capital-expenditure approval, which follows the separate SOP-FIN-002.

roles_responsibilities.responsibility: Submits the request with all required receipts attached
Reviews the request for completeness and approves or rejects within 3 business days

steps.text: Employee submits the expense-reimbursement request with itemized receipts.
Finance lead checks the request against the expense policy and either approves or returns it with a reason.
Approved requests are queued for payment in the next scheduled payment run.
